cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 22nd Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 22nd Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

privates.name: Deluxe 4 Bed Family Room Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Spacious ground-floor room with a queen bed and two single beds, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV, microwave, toaster, kettle, and private parking. Ideal for families seeking comfort and convenience. Pets are not allowed in this room.
